_meta.method: Live reads through the platform page-fetch tool, one row per statement published or relied on. A row says what was read, where, and whether it matches the record this repository holds. Nothing in this file is inferred; where a region of a page could not be retrieved, the row says so and the stored value is left as it was with its own dated citation.

Item details / Product details table rows on all five listing pages - not inside the retrievable chunks; ad and brand-store modules occupy that region of the fetched document (F-38, F-60).

Associates Program Operating Agreement Section 5 - the agreement page was retrieved and its Sections 1 to 4 were read today; the Section 5 sentence the site quotes verbatim was re-read on 2026-11-16 and 2026-11-17 (records data/verification-session-c509aba1.json and -1f4a7a22.json) and was not re-reached in today's chunk.
Google Search Console property state and any query or impression data - no account is connected (F-61).

rows.subject: Operating Agreement header and Sections 1 to 4
rows.read: Header 'Updated: October 15, 2025'. Section 1 defines Special Links as links that 'must properly use the special “tagged” link formats we provide' and defines Program Content as the data, images, text, link formats, widgets, links, marketing content and linking tools Amazon may make available. Section 2 makes compliance a condition of receiving commission income. Section 3 states Amazon's customers are not the Associate's customers. Section 4 opens the warranty list.
rows.result: Match with the agreement this site behaves under: the tagging rule (D-01/D-14, F-69, F-73) and the Program Content boundary that holds product imagery back (D-22, F-43) are both stated in today's read of Section 1.
